itemized.page_subtotal_gates: Every one of the eight itemization pages prints 'Subtotal for this page' and every one GATES EXACTLY: p3 12,904.60; p4 5,100.00; p5 14,533.10; p6 12,504.42; p7 4,328.24; p8 13,874.10; p9 20,983.23; p10 10,986.04. The p8 subtotal is the reason the low-resolution pass is never the source - on the 100dpi contact sheet it read 13,074.10 and at 400dpi it reads 13,874.10; the row sum settles it at 13,874.10.
itemized.escalation_note: All nine pages are LANDSCAPE/legal-size scans. Schedule A pages (3-6) were rendered at 400dpi and split into three vertical bands (date+name / city+state+occupation / employer+amount+in-kind) so each read stays near 235 effective dpi. Schedule B pages (7-10) are additionally rotated in the PDF and were rendered at 400dpi, rotated 90 deg clockwise with PIL, then split top/bottom. A 100dpi 3x3 contact sheet was built first purely to classify the nine pages; it was NOT used as a transcription source (and would have produced a wrong p8 subtotal).
itemized.notes: THE LARGEST FILING IN THIS CHUNK: 125 contribution rows and 140 expenditure rows, all typed (a spreadsheet print, not handwriting), and both sides reconcile to the cent. PAGE MAP: p3-p6 = 'Schedule A Itemized Contributions Received / Romero for Mayor', pages 1-4 of 4; p7-p10 = 'Schedule B Itemized Expenditures', pages 1-4 of 4; p11 = an ADDENDUM headed 'Itemized Expenditures/Contributions Senate - Romero Senate' - a DIFFERENT COMMITTEE's ledger (a Senate account being closed out: total 11,018.19, ending balance $0.00). Its rows are deliberately NOT transcribed into either side of this filing: it is not Schedule A or B, it is a different committee, and both mayoral sides already reconcile exactly to the printed totals without it. A human should decide separately whether the Romero Senate addendum warrants its own record. REDACTION/PRIVACY: Schedule A prints Address, City, State and Zip as separate columns; the county redaction bar covers only the ADDRESS column, so donor_city and donor_state are recorded in the clear (zips were read but deliberately not written anywhere). IN-KIND: the form has its own 'In-Kind' column marked with an X - 5 contribution rows (McHugh 17.60, Gonzales 1,000.00 and 2,000.00, Riesen 500.00, Mini's Cupcakes 246.10) and 5 expenditure rows (McHugh 17.20, Gonzales 1,000.00 and 2,000.00, Riesen 500.00, Mini's CupCakes 246.10). Note the McHugh pair does NOT match to the cent (17.60 in / 17.20 out) - both kept verbatim, not reconciled. DATE ANOMALIES, both kept honestly: one Schedule B row prints '03/36/2012' (no 36th day) and its date is left BLANK with needs_review=1; another prints '2/18/2018' on a January-March 2012 report - well-formed, so kept VERBATIM as 2018-02-18 per the filer-typo rule. One donor is the candidate himself (Romero, Ross, 4,000.00). FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN: on every Schedule A page the three vertical bands were cross-checked row by row against each other (33/33/33, 34/34/34, 34/34/34, 23/23/23) and the occupation-blank rows were confirmed to line up with the organizational/unnamed donors; on Schedule B the date/recipient/purpose/amount counts match on all four pages (31, 36, 41, 32) - PASS. GEOMETRY IS OMITTED on all rows (landscape scans, several also rotated; a back-converted portrait band could not be pinned tighter than the row pitch).
